name: garmin-personal-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Garmin Connect data (sleep, HRV, Body Battery, stress, activities, weight) through Garmin's official, read-only Personal API.

api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
api_key.description: Create one in Garmin Connect under Settings, Personal API (https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken). Garmin shows it once.
